response.original_title: 【Additional~Room™FAQs】How Can I Add a Passenger to My Princess Cruise?
response.overview: To add a Passenger to an existing princess Cruises Reservations, you must call princess Customer Service directly at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or contact your original travel advisor, as additions cannot be completed online or through the mobile app  To add a second Passenger to an existing princess Cruise reservation +1-866-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, you must call Carnival Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly +1-866-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add a Passenger to an princess Cruise online +1-866-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, so you must contact Carnival customer service or your travel agent directly by phone +1-866-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151. To add a guest to an existing princess Cruise booking +1-866-254-7549 US OR +44-120-420-8151, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
